(kha)༄༅/ /bum gter 'jug pa'i man ngag bzhugs/ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/mchod rten nam/gtsug lag khang ngam/khang bzang la sogs bzhengs pa'i gzhir bum gter 'ju

tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// bum gter 'jug pa'i man ngag bzhugs// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ mchod rten nam/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ khang bzang la sogs bzhengs pa'i gzhir bum gter 'jug par 'dod na/ bum pa yul gang yin gyi bre tshad pas mi chung ba'i bcud shong pa/ rin po che'i bum pa'am/ rdza la sogs pa'i yin na'ang*/ gtsang ma'i nang du rin po che sna tshogs dang*/ 'bru bcud dang sman dang dri bzang po nor sna dang*/ zas sna gos sna la sogs pa bcug la bsham/ de'ang ma 'byor na phyogs mtshams dbus dang dgur re re/ de ma 'byor na phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar re re/ yang na dbus su gcig 'jug pa yin/ de la bdag gi rnal 'byor gang yang rung ba bsgoms nas/ bzlas pa cung zad byas la bum gter bshams pa de/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis zad mi shes pa'i gter dang*/ longs spyod dang bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas bum pa'i stod kyi char/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba dang 'dab ma dgu rnams la nam̐ dgu las klu dgu bskyed par bya ste/ dbus su nor rgyas/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyong*/ nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du ba ru ṇa/ shar lhor 'jog po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du pad+ma/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa stod lha'i lus can phyag gnyis kas rin po che'i gter gyi bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ kha dog dag pa'i shel ltar dwangs shing yul gyi dbang po sna tshogs su snang ba/ spyi gtsug na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang bcas pa'i sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan zhing rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon phyogs nas rang dang 'dra ba'i chung mas brten par bskyed nas/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rgya mtsho chen po'i klong nas klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ e h+ye hi nā ga a dhi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod pas gnyis su med par bstim nas/

re re la'ang mchod pa dang gtor ma rgya chen po dbul zhing re re'i mchod pa'i mthar sngags bzlas par bya ste/ oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza ba su ka ye phuḥswā hā/ nor rgyas kyi'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza karko ṭā ya phuḥswā hā/ stobs kyi rgyu'i'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza shaṃ kha pā lā ya phuḥswā hā/ dung skyong gi'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza a nan+ta phuḥswā hā/ mtha' yas kyi'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza ba ru ṇā ya swā hā/ chu bdag ba ru ṇā'i'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza tak+ṣa kā ya phuḥswā hā/ 'jog po'i 'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza ku li ka ye phuḥswā hā/ rigs ldan gyi'o// oṃ phu nā ga rā dza pad+ma ye phuḥswā hā/ pad+ma'i'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza ma hā pad+ma ye phuḥswā hā/ pad+ma chen po'i 'o// mchod pa dang sngags rnams spel zhing byas nas/ klu'i gtor ma brgya rtsa la sogs phul la dngos grub rgyun mi chad par 'byung bar mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab nas/ 'dom gang la sogs pa'i sa brkos pa'i 'og tu byi dor legs par byas shing*/ sman dang dri bzang dang bcas te sa bzang po'i gnas su legs par bzhag la sgrom bu la sogs byas pa'i steng du sa gtsang mas legs par bkang ste 'thas par bya/ de'i steng du zhag bdun la sogs par dus gsum du mchod pa dang gtor ma dbul/ der dkon mchog gi rten la sogs pa bzhengs par bya'o// de ltar byas pas 'byor ba dang*/ lo legs pa dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung ba'i rten 'brel yin no// bum gter gzhug pa'i man ngag bla ma sa skya pas mdzad pa'o// rten bzhengs pa ma yin pa'i gter bum 'jug na'ang khang bzang ngam/ klu gnas pa'i sar bcug na yul der dpal 'phel bar 'gyur bas tshul 'di bzhin shes par bya'o// // ༄༅// khyung khra'i man ngag bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha' lding bsgom par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/

dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom/ de'i skad cig la bdag nyid nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po sbrul gyi steng du bzhugs pa/ pus mo man chad sa'i rang bzhin ser po/ brla chu'i rang bzhin dkar po/ lto ba me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ mgo bo rlung gi rang bzhin sngon po/ spyi bo dang gshog pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin kha dog sna tshogs pa/ rgyab dang dpung pa la sprin kha dog sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ klu'i rgyal po'i spyi gtsug nas nor bu rin po che phrogs nas g.yas phyogs kyi nam mkha' la bzhag ste sems can la dgos 'dod thams cad ster ba/ phyag g.yas pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas sems can dbugs 'byin pa/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pas sems can skrag par mdzad pa/ mgrin pa'i nang du rigs lnga'i ngo bo'i khyung*/ dbus su dkar po/ shar du sngon po/ lhor ser po/ nub tu dmar po/ byang du ljang gu bsam/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swā hā/ zhes pa ji ltar nus pa bzlas pas/ klu'i rigs kyi nad kyi mi tshugs pa yin no// gtor ma 'bul na ci 'byor pa bshams la/ yi ge gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la mdun du rang dang 'dra ba'i bya khyung cig bsams la/ sngar gyi sngags gsum mam/ lnga la sogs pas phul te/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la mi dmigs par bsam mo// bong nga za bar 'dod na sngon du bsnyen pa 'bum phrag lnga song nas lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du bong nga bzhag la/ mthe bong la sogs pa'i sor mo rnams la/ sngar gyi sngags kyis rim pa bzhin du kha dog dkar po la sogs pa bkod la/ ye ge rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ste/ bong nga la phog pas bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la bza' bar bya ste/ rtag tu zos na bcud len du'ang 'gyur ro// sbrul dang khyi smyon la sogs pa rnams kyi sos btab pa la sngags bzlas pa'i mchil ma btab pa dang*/ yi ge bkod pa'i lag pas byabs pas dug thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro// rje btsun nā ro pa'i gdams pa/

bla ma mal gyo las brgyud pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i gsung ngo*// i thi// //bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sa yi rang bzhin rnam dag pas// gti mug las byung dug rnams 'joms// chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid// bde gshegs mkha' lding phyag 'tshal bstod// chu yi rang bzhin rnam dag pas// zhe sdang las byung dug rnams 'joms// me long ye shes ngo bo nyid// rdo rje mkha' lding phyag 'tshal bstod// nam mkha'i rang bzhin rnam dag pas// ser sna las byung dug rnams 'joms// mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid// rin chen mkha' lding phyag 'tshal bstod// me yi rang bzhin rnam dag pas// 'dod chags las byung dug rnams 'joms// so sor rtog pa'i ngo bo nyid// pad+ma mkha' lding phyag 'tshal bstod// rlung gi rang bzhin rnam dag pas// phrag dog las byung dug rnams 'joms// bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid// las kyi mkha' lding phyag 'tshal bstod// brtan dang g.yo ba'i dug rnams 'joms// me dang chu bzhin 'joms mdzad pa/ rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos// mkha' lding khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// mkha' lding khyod la rab bstod pas// 'byung ba'i rang bzhin 'gro rnams kyi// brtan g.yo'i dug rnams rab zhi nas// dug rnams ye shes mngon gyur shog /rdo rje mkha' lding gi bstod pa'o// sh+lau ka bdun bzhugs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
